description: Before a sensitive action, ask whether it can happen now. For transfer_out, renew and cancel it returns state (eligible, action_required, blocked, in_progress), reasons with a code, the source (registry, namecom, nymwell), an until date when the block ends, the next action, and what the action requires (roles, Google confirmation, approval, payment). Staging checks the same rules again.
name: check_domain_eligibility
